name: @adventure-omakase/friends
description: A shared Japan fieldbook for friends, built on Workers, D1 and R2.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/dice-atlas.js && node --check public/controls.js && node --check public/bookings.js && node --check public/demo.js && node --check public/ask.js && node --check public/travel.js && node --check public/outings.js
scripts.test: pnpm compile && node --experimental-sqlite --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration.test.mjs tests/tooling.test.mjs tests/deployment.test.mjs tests/ask.test.mjs tests/travel.test.mjs tests/outings.test.mjs
